cases.sentence: На нем была ___, расстегнутая на груди.
options: рубаха
рубахи
рубахе
рубахой
cases.translation: He was wearing a shirt, unbuttoned at the chest.
cases.explain: Рубаха is the subject of была (was), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Самое характерное в его лице было отсутствие ___.
options: усы
усов
усам
усами
cases.translation: The most characteristic thing about his face was the absence of a mustache.
cases.explain: Отсутствие (absence) requires a genitive complement of what is absent: усов.

cases.sentence: Взять у его сиятельства записочку к ___ гимназии.
options: директор
директора
директору
директором
cases.translation: To get a note from his excellency to the headmaster of the gymnasium.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case: директору.

cases.sentence: Модест Алексеевич трогал ее за ___ и похлопывал по плечу.
options: талия
талии
талию
талией
cases.translation: Modest Alekseyich touched her by the waist and patted her on the shoulder.
cases.explain: The preposition за (by, indicating the part grasped) governs the accusative case here: талию.

cases.sentence: Это был чиновник среднего роста, довольно полный, с длинными ___ и без усов.
options: бакены
бакенов
бакенам
бакенами
cases.translation: He was an official of medium height, rather stout, with long sideburns and no mustache.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) expressing accompanying description governs the instrumental case: бакенами.

cases.sentence: У него в ___ 1100 и есть родовое имение.
options: банк
банка
банку
банке
cases.translation: He has eleven hundred in the bank, and an ancestral estate.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) marking location takes the prepositional case: банке.

reading.ru: После венчания не было даже легкой закуски.
reading.question: What was notably absent immediately after the wedding ceremony?
options: Even a light snack/reception
The wedding rings
A priest to bless the couple
Any guests at all
reading.correct: Even a light snack/reception
reading.explain: The story opens by noting there wasn't even a light snack after the wedding ceremony.

reading.ru: Молодые выпили по бокалу, переоделись и поехали на вокзал.
reading.question: What did the newlyweds do right after the ceremony instead of having a big celebration?
options: They each drank a glass, changed clothes, and went to the station
They danced all night at a ball
They went straight to their new home
They visited Anya's family first
reading.correct: They each drank a glass, changed clothes, and went to the station
reading.explain: Instead of a festive celebration, the newlyweds each had a glass, changed, and headed to the train station.

reading.ru: Многие одобрили это, говоря, что Модест Алексеевич уже в чинах и не молод.
reading.question: Why did many people approve of skipping a big wedding celebration?
options: Because Modest Alekseyich already held rank and was no longer young
Because the bride's family couldn't afford one
Because the church forbade large weddings
Because the groom was in mourning
reading.correct: Because Modest Alekseyich already held rank and was no longer young
reading.explain: Many approved, reasoning that Modest Alekseyich already held official rank and was no longer young, making a big celebration seem unfitting.

reading.ru: Аня наклонилась к нему из окна, и он шептал ей что-то, обдавая ее запахом винного перегара.
reading.question: What does Anya's father do as the train is about to depart?
options: He leans close and whispers to her, smelling of wine
He gives her a written blessing
He refuses to say goodbye
He hands her a letter to open later
reading.correct: He leans close and whispers to her, smelling of wine
reading.explain: Anya leans out the window and her father whispers something to her, his breath reeking of wine.

reading.ru: И какое у него было шалкое, доброе, виноватое лицо.
reading.question: How does Anya perceive her father's expression as the train pulls away?
options: Pitiful, kind, and guilty
Angry and bitter
Calm and indifferent
Proud and triumphant
reading.correct: Pitiful, kind, and guilty
reading.explain: As her father runs after the train, Anya sees his face as pitiful, kind, and guilty.

reading.ru: Модест Алексеевич осмотрелся в купе, разложил вещи по полкам и сел против своей молодой жены, улыбаясь.
reading.question: What does Modest Alekseyich do once alone with Anya in the train compartment?
options: He looks around, arranges his things on the shelves, and sits facing her, smiling
He immediately falls asleep
He begins reading official documents
He asks her to sing for him
reading.correct: He looks around, arranges his things on the shelves, and sits facing her, smiling
reading.explain: Once alone with Anya, Modest Alekseyich surveys the compartment, arranges his belongings, and sits down across from her, smiling.

reading.ru: Самое характерное в его лице было отсутствие усов.
reading.question: What does the narrator identify as the most distinctive feature of Modest Alekseyich's face?
options: The absence of a mustache
His piercing blue eyes
A large scar on his cheek
His unusually pale skin
reading.correct: The absence of a mustache
reading.explain: The narrator states that the most characteristic thing about his face was the lack of a mustache.

reading.ru: Пять лет назад, когда Казаротов получил орден Святой Анны Второй Степени и пришел благодарить, то его сиятельство выразилось так.
reading.question: What anecdote does Modest Alekseyich recall about a colleague named Kosorotov?
options: That his excellency made a joke about 'three Annas' when Kosorotov received the Order of St. Anna
That Kosorotov was fired for incompetence
That Kosorotov married a wealthy widow
That Kosorotov once insulted his excellency
reading.correct: That his excellency made a joke about 'three Annas' when Kosorotov received the Order of St. Anna
reading.explain: Modest Alekseyich recalls that when Kosorotov received the Order of St. Anna, Second Class, his excellency joked he now had three Annas — one on his lapel, two around his neck, referring also to his quarrelsome wife named Anna.

reading.ru: Мягкие движения его пухлого тела пугали ее.
reading.question: How does Anya feel about her new husband's physical presence?
options: The soft movements of his plump body frighten her
She finds him charming and elegant
She is indifferent to his appearance
She admires his athletic build
reading.correct: The soft movements of his plump body frighten her
reading.explain: The text says the soft movements of his plump body frightened her, and she felt both scared and disgusted.

reading.ru: Она вспомнила, как мучительно было венчание, когда казалось ей, что и священник, и гости, и все в церкови глядели на нее печально.
reading.question: How did Anya feel during the wedding ceremony itself, in retrospect?
options: Tormented, feeling that everyone in the church looked at her sorrowfully
Overjoyed and triumphant
Bored and impatient
Numb and unable to feel anything
reading.correct: Tormented, feeling that everyone in the church looked at her sorrowfully
reading.explain: She recalls the ceremony as agonizing, sensing that the priest, guests, and everyone in church looked at her sadly.

reading.ru: Вот она вышла за богатого, а денег у него все-таки не было.
reading.question: What irony does Anya realize about marrying a supposedly rich man?
options: She married a 'rich' man, yet he had no money after all
He was rich, but stingy with her
He was poor, but pretended to be wealthy
He gave all his money away to charity
reading.correct: She married a 'rich' man, yet he had no money after all
reading.explain: The narrator notes the irony that although she married for money, he turned out not to actually have any.

reading.ru: Когда умерла мать, отец Петр Леонтьич, учитель чистописания и рисования в кимназии, запил
reading.question: How did Anya's father, Pyotr Leontyich, react to his wife's death?
options: He started drinking heavily
He quit his teaching job
He moved the family to another city
He remarried within a year
reading.correct: He started drinking heavily
reading.explain: After his wife's death, Pyotr Leontyich, a calligraphy and drawing teacher, took to drink.

reading.ru: У мальчиков не было сапог и калош.
reading.question: What sign of poverty does the text mention about Anya's younger brothers?
options: They had no boots or galoshes
They had no winter coats
They had no schoolbooks
They had no beds to sleep in
reading.correct: They had no boots or galoshes
reading.explain: Amid the family's hardship, the boys had no boots or galoshes.

reading.ru: Аня должна была укаживать за пьяным отцом, штопать братьям чулки и ходить на рынок.
reading.question: What responsibilities fell on young Anya due to her family's situation?
options: Caring for her drunken father, darning her brothers' socks, and going to market
Managing the household's finances and paying servants
Teaching her brothers at home instead of school
Working a full-time job to support the family
reading.correct: Caring for her drunken father, darning her brothers' socks, and going to market
reading.explain: Anya had to look after her drunk father, mend her brothers' stockings, and go to the market.

reading.ru: Но вот знакомые дамы засуетились и стали искать для Ани хорошего человека.
reading.question: How did Anya come to be introduced to Modest Alekseyich?
options: Acquaintance ladies bustled about looking for a good match for her
Her father arranged the match himself
She met him at a school event
Artynov introduced them
reading.correct: Acquaintance ladies bustled about looking for a good match for her
reading.explain: Family acquaintances took it upon themselves to find Anya a suitable husband, which led to Modest Alekseyich.

reading.ru: У него в банке 1100 и есть родовое имение, которое он отдает в аренду.
reading.question: What financial assets does Modest Alekseyich have, according to the matchmaking ladies?
options: 1,100 in the bank and an ancestral estate he rents out
A large inheritance from his late father
A share in a factory in Kharkov
No savings but a government pension
reading.correct: 1,100 in the bank and an ancestral estate he rents out
reading.explain: The ladies note he has 1,100 in the bank and an ancestral estate that he leases out.

reading.ru: Был тут и Артынов, владелец всего этого дачного места, богач, высокий полный брюнет, похожий лицом на армянина, с глазами на выкате в странном костюме.
reading.question: How is Artynov, the wealthy dacha owner, described when Anya sees him at the station?
options: A tall, stout, dark-haired rich man resembling an Armenian, with bulging eyes and odd clothes
A thin, sickly old man in a wheelchair
A young, shy student with glasses
A uniformed military officer
reading.correct: A tall, stout, dark-haired rich man resembling an Armenian, with bulging eyes and odd clothes
reading.explain: Artynov is described as a tall, stout, dark brunette resembling an Armenian, with bulging eyes and an unusual costume.

reading.ru: Заметив, что на нее смотрит Артынов, она кокетливо прищурила глаза и заговорила громко по-французски
reading.question: How does Anya react upon noticing Artynov watching her?
options: She coquettishly narrows her eyes and starts speaking loudly in French
She hides behind her husband in embarrassment
She runs back into the train compartment
She ignores him completely
reading.correct: She coquettishly narrows her eyes and starts speaking loudly in French
reading.explain: Noticing Artynov's gaze, Anya flirtatiously narrows her eyes and begins speaking loudly in French to impress him.

reading.ru: Молодые пробыли в монастыре два дня, потом вернулись в город.
reading.question: How long did the newlyweds stay at the monastery before returning to the city?
options: Two days
One week
A single night
A month
reading.correct: Two days
reading.explain: The text states the newlyweds spent two days at the monastery before returning to the city.

reading.ru: И, держа нож в кулаке, как меч, он говорил
reading.question: What does Modest Alekseyich do while lecturing at the dinner table, holding his knife like a sword?
options: He declares that every person must have their duties
He demands more wine be served
He criticizes the quality of the food
He announces a promotion at work
reading.correct: He declares that every person must have their duties
reading.explain: Holding his knife in his fist like a sword, Modest Alekseyich pronounces that every person must have their responsibilities.

reading.ru: Петя и Андрюша — худенькие, бледные мальчишки с большими глазами.
reading.question: How are Anya's younger brothers Petya and Andryusha described?
options: Thin, pale boys with big eyes
Chubby and rosy-cheeked
Tall and athletic
Sickly and bedridden
reading.correct: Thin, pale boys with big eyes
reading.explain: Petya and Andryusha are described as thin, pale boys with large eyes, worried about their father's drinking.

reading.ru: Я никому не позволю дозираться мной!
reading.question: What does Pyotr Leontyich shout when his children try to stop him from drinking?
options: That he won't allow anyone to oversee/control him
That he will leave the house forever
That he will report them to the police
That he no longer loves them
reading.correct: That he won't allow anyone to oversee/control him
reading.explain: Pyotr Leontyich flares up, banging his fist on the table and shouting that he won't let anyone control him.

reading.ru: Только один раз Петр Леонтьич осмелился попросить у него 50 рублей взаймы, чтобы заплатить какой-то очень неприятный долг.
reading.question: What did Pyotr Leontyich once dare to ask Modest Alekseyich for?
options: A loan of 50 rubles to pay off an unpleasant debt
Permission to visit Anya alone
A job at the government office
A letter of recommendation
reading.correct: A loan of 50 rubles to pay off an unpleasant debt
reading.explain: Only once did Pyotr Leontyich dare ask Modest Alekseyich for a loan of 50 rubles to pay off a very unpleasant debt.

reading.ru: Не могу не напомнить вам общеизвестного факта, что многих способных людей погубила эта страсть
reading.question: What warning does Modest Alekseyich give Pyotr Leontyich when lending him money?
options: That this passion (drink) has ruined many capable people
That he must never ask again
That he should retire from teaching
That Anya will be disinherited
reading.correct: That this passion (drink) has ruined many capable people
reading.explain: While agreeing to lend the money, Modest Alekseyich warns that this passion (for drink) has destroyed many capable people.

reading.ru: Но зато он дарил Анне кольца, браслеты, броши, говоря, что эти вещи хорошо иметь про черный день.
reading.question: What does Modest Alekseyich give Anya instead of spending money on her family?
options: Rings, bracelets, and brooches, saying they're good to have for a rainy day
A generous monthly allowance
A trip to Paris
A private tutor for her brothers
reading.correct: Rings, bracelets, and brooches, saying they're good to have for a rainy day
reading.explain: Instead, he gave Anya rings, bracelets, and brooches, saying such things are good to have for a rainy day, while periodically checking they were all still there.
